_comment: KG Gold Garden caretaker settings. Safe to edit by hand.
_autoRestoreRates: When true, if the site falls back to demo rates the agent re-posts the LAST RATE YOU SET yourself. It never invents a number. Leave false until you say go.
_maxRestoreAgeDays: Refuse to auto-restore a saved rate older than this many days; alert instead. Gold moves daily.
_timeoutSeconds: Render free tier cold-starts can take 60s+. Be patient.
_retries: Extra attempts if the ping fails outright.
_keepLogDays: Delete heartbeat logs older than this.
